resources.string: Auto-replies with GPS coordinates via Internet or SMS when trigger code is received

Welcome to TrackPhone!

To help locate your phone if lost or misplaced, TrackPhone accesses your device's precise GPS location and transmits it via Internet or SMS ONLY when triggered by your secret keyword from authorized requestors.

By tapping "I Agree", you explicitly consent to:
1. Allowing TrackPhone to retrieve your GPS coordinates upon secret trigger.
2. Transmitting your location via Internet or SMS to authorized requestors.
3. Displaying notification alerts whenever your location is requested and shared.
Send Request via Internet (Free / No Load)
Open Lost Phone Location in Maps
Manually enter this phone\'s number (essential for dual-SIM phones or custom device ID).
Only allow location requests from this specific phone number. Leave blank to allow any number.

1. Manually input your phone number in settings (great for dual-SIM phones).
2. When internet is on, TrackPhone automatically syncs live location updates to the cloud.
3. Use "Fetch Live Cloud Location" or "Send via Internet" to locate your phone instantly without using cellular SMS load!
